bio: Archetype: AoE DPT, Extra Action, Crit-Rate Dependent. ⌽ Accumulates [Eureka] when casting an incantation or when an ally takes an Extra Action. ⌽ When reaching 5 [Eureka], consumes all [Eureka] to cast an FUA [Supplementary Formula]. ⌽ Ult provides [Eureka] for self and ATK buff for team. ⌽ Insight 3 grants additional Crit Rate and allows own Genesis DMG to crit; effective against enemies with high DEF/DMG Taken Reduction. ⌽ Extremely squishy; needs good defensive support.
